transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you in to see me?

I keep getting up when I’m supposed to be sitting still—during meetings, or even at dinner. I’ll suddenly decide I need more coffee, need to check a handout, or walk to the back of the room, even though it’s not really urgent.
Did you have this same difficulty staying seated when you were a child?
Yes. My report cards used to say I was bright, but that I couldn’t stay in my seat or wait my turn. My mother joked I’d worn a path from my desk to the pencil sharpener before I was ten.
Aside from feeling restless, do you often have trouble staying focused on tasks or conversations?
I’m not sure I’d say I have much trouble focusing. I can usually follow a conversation or get through what I need to do.
